items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: He was a fine fellow. You know what I mean by that, uh, he was very respectable. He really was nice.

ctx.x: He could play that base too.

Yeah. He was a fine fellow. You know what I mean by that, uh, he was very respectable. He really was nice. Very nice. Very nice. But, uh, he just fretted about his wife going down in that canal, you know. That really grieved him. Never was the same out of the way.
Did I ask you if you knew a trumpet player named Guzi or something like that? Guzi or Guzi or something like that? Yeah.
